text:
Some trees are transparent and can speak
several languages at once; others, algebraic,
converse with the air in the grave manner
of stars; others
look like horses and neigh;

among them
are incredible mad types for being motherless;
the chord
of the mist is enough for them.

At night they paint what they see, generate and
divinize another space with another sex unlike
that of Genesis; they sing
and paint at once, more than the craft
of creation, the old craft
of silence

before wonder; they bind the androgynous
net within the weave
of a single body,
tree and resurrected animal,
with the ten thousand senses
we lost at birth;

then
we are another sun.

translation.title: Some Trees Are Transparent and Know How to Speak...
